paragraphs.text: Pune International Airport (PNQ/VAPO) serves as a key air gateway for Pune, IN, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 10/28: 3048 m (10000 ft) asphalt, 14/32: 1796 m (5893 ft) asphalt.
Ground transportation options connecting Pune International Airport with central Pune include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from PNQ should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Pune International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Pune International Airport is PNQ and the ICAO code is VAPO.

faqs.q: Which city does PNQ airport serve?
faqs.a: Pune International Airport (PNQ) serves Pune, IN.
